analysis.title: Breville Group (BRG.AX): WSM 3Q26 a very slight negative read through
key_insights: Williams-Sonoma (WSM), a key Breville customer, reported 3Q26 results overnight. WSM stock fell about 15% on the day on a top-line miss and high investor expectations.
WSM group comparable sales were +5.1%, below GS consensus of +6.4% and FactSet consensus of +5.6%.

GS sees the WSM update as only a slight incremental negative for BRG, because demand in the key Williams Sonoma brand appears to have moderated only modestly (like-for-like sales growth slowed from 7.6% in 2Q26 to 6.8% in 3Q26).
WSM management called out the BRG Auto Pour-Over Coffee Machine, exclusive to WSM, as the gift of the season, which GS counts as a positive for BRG.
GS retains a Buy rating on BRG with a 12-month target price of A$37.70 (price A$31.91, 18.1% upside).

market_movers.rationale: GS retains Buy on Breville Group. The WSM 3Q26 read-through is a slight incremental negative, partly offset by WSM naming the BRG Auto Pour-Over Coffee Machine as the gift of the season.

WSM stock fell about 15% after 3Q26 group comparable sales of +5.1% missed GS (+6.4%) and FactSet (+5.6%) consensus. WSM is covered by Kate McShane, and this note does not state her rating or price target.

earnings_insights: WSM 3Q26 (reported overnight, 19 Nov 2026 US session): group comparable sales +5.1% reported vs GS consensus +6.4% and FactSet consensus +5.6%. Stock down about 15% on the day.
WSM 3Q26 Williams Sonoma brand like-for-like sales growth +6.8% reported vs +7.6% in 2Q26.

GS BRG estimates: EPS A$0.95 for FY 6/26, A$1.05 forecast for 6/27E, A$1.18 for 6/28E and A$1.34 for 6/29E. Half-year EPS: A$0.68 (12/25), A$0.27 (6/26), A$0.74 forecast (12/26E), A$0.31 forecast (6/27E).
GS BRG revenue: A$1,810.9mn for FY 6/26, forecast A$1,925.4mn for 6/27E, A$2,121.0mn for 6/28E and A$2,366.1mn for 6/29E.
